rows.author: G052;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR ENSURING THE
AVAILABILITY, ADEQUACY, ACCESSIBILITY, AND SAFETY OF FOOD FOR ALL
FILIPINOS
rows.abstract:
Enumerates State´s obligations to protect and fulfill the Filipinos´ right to adequate food and lays out specific percentage targets on the reduction of hunger, ultimately aiming for the zero incidence of forced hunger within a ten-year period; Creates the Commission on the Right to Adequate Food under the Office of the President.
Seeks to clarify institutional responsibilities of the different line agencies to address the following areas of concern:  

a) food availability, stability and adequacy; b) food quality and safety; c) determination of the standards on the minimum amount of food for any person suffering from hunger or under nutrition; c) physical and economic access to food; and d) well-functioning distribution, processing and market systems.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on FOOD SECURITY since 2022-09-13

rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING PREFERENCE TO DOMESTIC BIDDERS PARTICIPATING IN
GOVERNMENT PROCUREMENT PROJECTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
rows.abstract:
Institutionalizes the Certification Program of Domestic Bidders to encourage all local suppliers and manufacturers (particularly those in the countryside); and also serves to provide assurances that the government is one with all industries and sectors in supporting local labor and products that will definitely contribute to the realization of the goals of the Tatak Pinoy campaign.
Refers Domestic Bidder to any person or entity offering unmanufactured articles, materials or supplies of the growth or production of the Philippines, or manufactured articles, materials, or supplies manufactured or to be manufactured in the Philippines substantially from articles, materials, or supplies of the growth, production, or manufacture, as the case may be, of the Philippines.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE OPEN ELECTRONIC LEARNING SCHOOL SYSTEM IN
THE PHILIPPINES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER
PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes an ELearning or Cyber Education as an alternative mode of learning - aims to cover public secondary and tertiary educational institutions with existing distance learning programs and all other such institutions that shall later be authorized as qualified.

Defines Open Electronic Learning School or ELearning as a system of delivering educational services . . . utilizing print, radio, television, and computer-based communications, satellite broadcasting, teleconferencing, and other multimedia learning and teaching technologies that allow students to study on their own without having to regularly attend class in conventional classrooms.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LEARNING CITIES, MANDATING
COMPLIANCE WITH THE KEY FEATURES THEREOF, AND APPROPRIATING
FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Defines Lifelong Education as “all types of systematic educational activities other than regular school curriculum, including supplementary education, basic literacy education for adults, ability enhancement education, culture and art education, and citizen´s participation education.”
Proposes for the following provisions:  Mandates the DepEd, CHED, and TESDA to jointly create a master plan for establishing Learning Cities; In coordination with the DILG, may designate a locality as a Learning City; and Heads of LGUs designated as Learning Cities shall be required to guide and support activities for the promotion of lifelong education whether initiated by the LGU or private lifelong educational institutions.
rows.status: Substituted by HB11543

rows.abstract:
Seeks to make the young generation more socially equipped for nation-building by instilling in them the love of country through the immersion of the students under the MTP, which will prepare them for war and any civil disaster, unrest, and other calamities.
Proposes to make it mandatory for Grades 11 and 12 students under Senior High School to undergo MTP that shall form part of the curricula and shall consist of the following:  The Reserve Officers´ Training Corps (ROTC); First Responders´ Service Training (FiRST); and Environmental and Community Service Training (EnCoST).
